subject: spanish
title: Basic Colours
final_note: Colours for clothes, objects, anything visual.

walkthroughs.body_html: The three primary colours: rojo (red), amarillo (yellow), azul (blue). 'J' sounds like 'h' — say 'ROH-ho'.
Negro (black) and blanco (white). With feminine nouns they change: negra, blanca. Most colours follow this -o/-a pattern.
